description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Data utilities] Normalises up to 50 URLs offline: lowercases scheme and host, drops default ports, fragments, credentials and known tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid and similar), then removes duplicates; reports what changed per URL. Input: urls separated by spaces or new lines (or a JSON array via POST). No URL is fetched.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

urls.description: 1-50 http(s) URLs separated by spaces or new lines (or a JSON array in a POST body)

name: url_clean

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: URL cleaner: strip tracking parameters, normalise, dedupe (up to 50) ($0.002/call)
